scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "GATEWAY,API,UI" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "GATEWAY,API,UI" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run start:gateway" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run build:java
